system.description:
A stat bolstered by external means—bio, tech, or mystical—without redefining who you are.

  • Level 1: +1 to selected stat
  • Level 2: +2 to selected stat
  • Level 3: +3 to selected stat
  • Level 4: +4 to selected stat
  • Level 5: +5 to selected stat
  • Level 6: +6 to selected stat
